subject: Adding GRG Halo device into the device allow list (#3954)
summary: Adds the "8065s" device name string to the same if-branch in identify_rocm_arch_from_name() that already maps "8050s" and "8060s" to the gfx1151 ROCm architecture, enabling GRG-Halo GPUs to be recognized instead of reported as unsupported.
verdict_reason: The PR was approved by @fl0rianr whose documented subject areas (LMX models, GUI, CI, smart router) do not cover ROCm or hardware vendor support, despite the project's guidance that at least one reviewer should have domain expertise.
